description: A massive horned brute seen very close, filling the picture from the chest up and facing the viewer head-on. Its head is bull-like and bony, with two long pale horns sweeping out to the sides, small slanted green eyes, a pink fleshy muzzle and a wide mouth of white fangs. Its huge shoulders and arms are a mottled rust-brown, rough as bark, crossed by a thick grey rope or chain strap running diagonally over the chest. The curved grey blade of a great axe rises behind its right shoulder. The background is black, and the light is dim and earthy, giving a menacing, crowded feeling. Frame 1: the mouth gapes open in a roar, fangs bared and nostrils flared. Frame 2: the jaws close partly to a lower snarl, the eyes narrowing. The open roar holds for a moment and the closed snarl holds a little longer, so the loop reads as slow, heavy growling breaths.
title: Horned beast-man snarling closely
